declared: ROBO-ARENA protocol, committed before any run on the held-out seeds 7121–7180 (loop 10 round 6b)

training.demonstrations: COLEARN colSyntheticDemos, labelled synthetic: scripted expert at skill 0.85 with action noise 0.3, seed 1 (episode seeds 100004+), 40 per gym task, 20 per station; learners keep clean passes only, except step-reward (steps dropped by its reward model, no run filter)
training.heldOutTasks: the three hard variants are never trained on: every learned model trains on the base task's demonstrations and is run on the variant
training.dagger: rounds 1 and 3, 20 rollouts per round on seeds 800100+; labels are the scripted expert's action on the clone's states, not a person's
training.stepReward: 200 synthetic window pairs (rt8WindowPairs, seed 1), 150 fit rt6FitReward, drop a step when sigmoid(reward − median) < 0.25
training.ra-lm: one model for all nine trained tasks (six gym base tasks, three stations); task text = scenario name, blurb, actions, rules, variant parameters and the linked station's step titles, prompts and hazards (exports/unity/SmartCitiX/Content/stations/*.json); station steps add the current step's text; TF-IDF hashed into 24 buckets; masked softmax over tᵀ·W·[s,1]; continuous parameters from the 5 nearest training moments of the same task and label; consented takes: none present headless
training.devDisclosure: development used seeds 1–20 only (gym) and 1–3 (stations): the cache key fix, the reactive agent's n/a scenarios, and the ra-lm parameter head (ridge regression replaced by nearest moments after teleop scored 0 of 20 on dev seeds). Nothing was run on 7121–7180 before this commit.

governor: vbGovernor.monitor on every step of a seeded safe simulated job at the scenario's site (half the rig's speed limit, nearest person 8 m); a broken rule is a deviation and the governor halts the run with a protective stop; target always the simulator

metrics.success: the scenario's own pass (rb-env summary.passed) and no governor stop
metrics.ruleBreaks: count of safe-practice rule violations reported by the scenario (before the halt)
metrics.governorChecked: steps the governor monitored / steps run (declared threshold: 1.000)
metrics.physical: dispatches to a non-sim target (declared threshold: 0)
metrics.interval: Wilson score 95% per proportion; Newcombe hybrid score 95% for a difference

comparisons.leaderboard: pooled success over the nine gym scenarios per family (reactive only where ROBOTRAIN-7 wrote rules; DAgger and step-reward gym only), and over all twelve
comparisons.smallModelHeadline: ra-lm minus bc, pooled success on the three hard variants (held-out tasks), seeds 7121–7180, 180 episodes each; measured once; reported whatever it is, with the Newcombe interval
comparisons.smallModelSecondary: ra-lm minus bc over all twelve scenarios on the held-out seeds; and ra-lm minus the text ablation (the same model and data with the instruction blanked)
comparisons.noClaim: no claim is made from a difference whose interval spans 0
